subject.title: Enhancement: Developer experience quick wins from code analysis

question: Should this umbrella stay open as one tracker or split, and what operator-visible surface should non-tool skill prompt rewrites use?
rationale: The missing code paths are clear, but status performance boundaries and prompt-rewrite warning UX require maintainer intent before an automated implementation should proceed.

options.title: Split focused follow-ups
options.body: Track status registry diagnostics separately from prompt-rewrite diagnostics, choose the warning surface first, and keep each implementation bounded with tests.

options.title: Keep this umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker for both remaining quick wins, accepting that implementation crosses status, skills, docs, and tests.

options.title: Narrow to status diagnostics
options.body: Treat existing skill command behavior and docs as enough for prompt-rewrite discovery and keep only the status registry diagnostics request.

recommendation.title: Split focused follow-ups
recommendation.body: Track status registry diagnostics separately from prompt-rewrite diagnostics, choose the warning surface first, and keep each implementation bounded with tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already posted the prior keep-open review and is the clearest routing candidate for the product-surface decision.
